note: Every change made because of a dev finding, in order. Diagnosis uses only the two dev conversations (conv-26, conv-30; 233 questions). Each version is measured on dev; the test run uses only the final version, and the eight other conversations are reported apart as held-out.

iterations.finding: Ingesting conv-30 failed: on one crowded session the extractor's answer hit the 3,072-token output cap (OLLAMA_NUM_PREDICT). The job failed all 5 attempts identically (temperature 0), and every later session of that conversation queued behind it, so the whole memory bank stalled.
iterations.change: A window whose answer is cut off at the output cap is split in half and each half is extracted on its own; only a single event that still does not fit fails the job. New error variant AppError::OutputLimit; regression test a_window_whose_answer_hits_the_output_cap_is_split_until_each_part_fits.
iterations.dev_before: conv-30 bank could not be built
iterations.dev_after: The retried conv-30 job split a 26-event window (engine log, 10:43:30Z) and succeeded; the bank finished extracting.

iterations.finding: In conv-26, 'I went to a LGBTQ support group yesterday' said on 8 May 2023 was stored with event_at 8 May and the statement 'on 2023-05-08': the student copies the message time instead of resolving the relative day (the known date fault in Chapter 5). LoCoMo's gold answer is 7 May.
iterations.change: After review, a claim whose own quotes name exactly one relative day (yesterday, tomorrow, N days ago, in N days, last/next/this <weekday>, last night) and whose event_at is the day the message was sent has event_at, a matching valid_from and the date spelled in its statement moved to the named day. Two disagreeing expressions or a period ('last week') change nothing. Unit tests mentioned_day_resolves_one_relative_day_and_refuses_the_rest and a_relative_day_in_the_quote_moves_a_copied_message_date.

iterations.finding: Harness bug: recall reports a source by its session name (session_19), but the harness labelled evidence as conv-26:session_19, so session recall and the quote check would have scored zero.
iterations.change: Evidence sessions and the quote check use the session name, which is unique within one conversation's bank.

iterations.finding: Once a LoCoMo speaker had about a dozen sessions of assertions, every consolidation job for that speaker failed before sending a request: up to 100 active assertions made a prompt of about 12,100 tokens, over the 12,288-token context once the 3,072-token answer is reserved. conv-30 lost 6 of its first 10 consolidations and conv-26 12; such a bank gets no inferences for its main speakers.
iterations.change: Consolidation keeps the newest assertions whose prompt fits the context with a repair reserve and no more than the 6,000-token prompts the student was trained on (fit_newest, the same bound extraction uses), and logs how many it left out. Unit test consolidation_keeps_the_newest_assertions_that_fit.
iterations.dev_before: 18 of 28 consolidations failed across the two dev banks
iterations.dev_after: all 38 consolidations of the two dev banks succeed; on conv-26 one job kept the newest 38 of 81 assertions

iterations.finding: Harness fault: restarting the engine while a bank was being built crashed the ingest stage (connection refused) instead of waiting for the engine to return.
iterations.change: Every engine call in ingest, recall and the property suite retries for about 15 minutes before giving up.
iterations.dev_before: ingest stage exited on an engine restart

iterations.finding: Harness and API fault: /api/v2/jobs returns only the newest 100 jobs, and a LoCoMo bank makes hundreds of projection jobs, so the harness never saw conv-26's 12 failed consolidations and marked the bank ready.
iterations.change: /api/v2/jobs accepts status=failed (and any other status). The harness decides readiness from the status endpoint, which counts every job, and fetches failed jobs by status to retry them.
iterations.dev_before: conv-26 reported ready with 12 failed consolidations
iterations.dev_after: the 12 were found, retried on the v3 engine and succeeded; both dev banks have all 19 extractions and 19 consolidations

iterations.finding: Property suite on the v3 engine: in 4 of 12 knowledge updates ('Big news: I moved from Hobart to Accra last weekend, so I live in Accra now') the extractor proposed a correction and the review model vetoed it ('source does not confirm replacement'), leaving both cities contested. In 'I will present at the design review in three days' said on 11 April the model wrote 15 April, which the v2 rule left alone because it only corrected copied message dates.
iterations.change: A correction is not vetoed when its own quote states the change in words (moved from, switched to, no longer, sold my, left ... and started, correction:); the guard never turns an ordinary claim into a correction. The relative-day rule now also replaces a miscounted model date. The review prompt (a frozen model contract) is unchanged. Unit tests a_veto_does_not_undo_a_change_the_quote_states and the miscounted case in a_relative_day_in_the_quote_moves_a_copied_message_date.
iterations.dev_before: knowledge_update old value superseded 8/12; relative_date resolved 8/12 (3 of the 4 misses were events never extracted)

iterations.finding: On the two dev conversations, assertions alone (the v1 'enhanced' design) answered 0.459 (Jev) against 0.798 for plain retrieval over source chunks; 77 of its 126 misses were questions whose evidence turn no stored assertion cites, i.e. the extractor's coverage. Mixing source text in (include_raw) reached 0.768, because assertions match several channels and outrank the source text in one fused list. Every retrieval condition also packed only about 2k of its 8,192-token budget because top_k was 20.
iterations.change: Recall with source text packs source chunks and assertions alternately, each in its own ranked order (packing_order). The engine condition is now this hybrid; assertions alone stays as the ablation 'assertions_only'. top_k is 60 for every retrieval condition, so the token budget, not the hit count, bounds the context. Unit test source_text_and_assertions_alternate_when_mixed.
iterations.dev_before: assertions only 0.459; mixed by fused rank 0.768 (top_k 20), 0.807 (top_k 60); plain retrieval 0.824 (top_k 60)
iterations.dev_after: hybrid 0.828 at top_k 60 (multi-hop 0.77 vs 0.67, open-domain 0.85 vs 0.77 for plain retrieval; 7,046 context tokens, 43% of full context)
